final: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM telescopes AS t JOIN signals AS s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus), status_averages AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse FROM telescope_averages GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean_pulse FROM status_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse, sa.avg_pulse - fm.mean_pulse AS excess_first FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm WHERE sa.avg_pulse > fm.mean_pulse), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean_pulse FROM first_kept), remaining AS (SELECT fk.avg_pulse, fk.excess_first, fk.avg_pulse - sm.mean_pulse AS excess_second FROM first_kept AS fk CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm WHERE fk.avg_pulse > sm.mean_pulse) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse), AVG(excess_first), AVG(excess_second) FROM remaining
